We help with divorce and separation, child custody, wills and estates, and land and tenancy disputes. A first consultation lasts 30 minutes and costs 20,000 naira. Explain how a matter starts: you book a consultation, you bring your documents, and we explain your options and our fees in writing before any work begins. Office hours are Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm. Add a form to request a consultation with name, phone, email and a short note about the matter, and thank people afterwards.
